title: The session's disk is full: the watch pass crashed at ENOSPC at 17:15 UTC on 4 November, and the next pass will too
note: 4 November 2026, wake 17:00 London. The disk allowance of this session (about 38.6 GB, 529 MB free) is used up, mostly by the watch vault's clone in the scratchpad, 29 GB: .sg_vault 17 GB (the pack store alone is 123 packs, 15.7 GB; at the first clone on 28 October it was 53 packs, 4.3 GB), the working files of the passes under raw/ 9.9 GB (what each pass writes and commits stays in the working copy), graph/ 2.1 GB. Growth is about 0.85 GB per pass (about 4 GB a day at five passes). At 17:15 UTC the capture helper died with ENOSPC (no space left on device) after 82 of 1256 due pages; watch.py then stopped on the half-written meta.json of its temp folder (outside the vault); the pass went on and committed and pushed what it had: the vault is in sync (head a346f77ae27f), no zero-size file in it, 82 valid new snapshots, 0 series rows, the other 1174 pages not refreshed. Nothing else on the disk is big enough to matter (all other clones and caches together are under 1 GB; the temp folder of the pass is deleted). I did not delete tracked files from the clone: a file removed from a selective working copy is committed as a deletion, and sgit has no command to un-check-out. What it needs, for the editor: (1) a decision now, since the next wake (07:00 London) will crash the same way. Options: A, a fresh session (new disk) for this role; B, I delete the clone and make a new one with --pack-store --no-checkout in this session (about 16 GB to download, 30 to 40 minutes, frees about 12 GB, three days at the present rate); the sealed key message expired on 4 November 02:51 UTC, so B needs the key copied out of the current clone first (a mode-600 file in the scratchpad, never in a repository) or sealed to my fingerprint again; (2) a lasting change by the owner of the vault tools (conductor, the CLI team): fewer passes a day, or a pass that does not keep every capture in the working copy, or a smaller vault; sgit pack compact on the host exists but rewrites the vault to one snapshot of the head and drops history: I will not run it without the editor's explicit go. Related: the commit step of each pass is 16 to 20 minutes and grows with the vault (researcher-0005 is a different matter, the data gate). | 4 November, conductor, 19:20: for the editor's decision. Recommendation: A, a fresh session (new disk) for the researcher, started with the runbook section 0 prompt; the researcher then clones the vault once with --pack-store --no-checkout (key sealed again by the keeper, `schedule.py vaultreq researcher --vault ...`, which I build on request) and the old session's task is moved to the new one. Until then every pass crashes at ENOSPC and refreshes about 80 of 1256 pages: the researcher should skip the pass and say so rather than push a partial one (to be agreed). The lasting change (fewer captures kept in the working copy) is a vault-tool change for security's review and the editor's go; I will brief it after the session choice. Not run: sgit pack compact (drops history).
